questions.question_text: What is the main danger of overloading your vehicle?
options: The car will use more fuel
It makes the vehicle harder to steer and lengthens stopping distances
It will damage the car's paintwork
It is only dangerous for the engine
questions.explanation: Excessive weight impacts braking efficiency and handling, making the car less responsive.

questions.question_text: What represents the main danger associated with overloading a vehicle?
options: It will make the engine run hotter than normal
It increases the likelihood of the car breaking down
It affects the vehicle's stability, steering, and braking performance
It will drain the battery faster than usual
questions.explanation: Overloading significantly changes how a car handles, making it harder to steer and increasing the distance required to stop.

questions.question_text: How does an overloaded car affect your driving?
options: It improves fuel efficiency
It makes the car easier to steer
It affects the car's braking and steering performance
It reduces the risk of accidents
questions.explanation: Excessive weight changes how a vehicle handles and increases the effort required to stop it.

questions.question_text: How will an overloaded vehicle affect your driving?
options: It will make the steering feel lighter
It will reduce the distance required to stop
It will make the handling and braking less responsive
It will improve the vehicle's fuel efficiency
questions.explanation: Excess weight affects a vehicle's stability, steering, and significantly increases the distance required to come to a complete stop.

questions.question_text: When loading a roof rack, what should you keep in mind?
options: There is no weight limit
Ensure the load is secure and doesn't exceed the manufacturer's limit
Place the heaviest items at the back
Load it only when driving in city traffic
questions.explanation: Overloading or improperly securing roof loads can cause them to fall off or affect the car's balance.
